provenance: Re-run of the full DSA case inside the repository's official uv.lock environment (isolated project environment, `uv sync --locked --group dev`, uv.lock unmodified). Separate from the earlier case-parity and macOS runs; the frozen Linux baseline was recorded with different dependency versions (scikit-learn 1.8.0 vs 1.9.0).

detail.scope: frozen baseline recorded on Linux; cross-platform float differences must be reported, never hidden

equivalence_with_macos_parity_run.interpretation: On this case the official-lock dependency versions (scikit-learn 1.9.0, pandas 3.0.5, ...) reproduce the macOS 1.8.0/2.2.3 parity run exactly. The difference against the frozen Linux baseline is therefore the same platform-associated difference already recorded, not a new version-related one; its cause remains unconfirmed.

difference_vs_frozen_linux_baseline.retained: Hard predictions and label-based metrics match the frozen baseline; only the probability-derived ROC-AUC differs (~2.03e-7), as previously recorded. Tolerances, protocol and baseline were not changed.

scope.statement: Software conformance inside one recorded locked environment; not external or clinical validation and not a claim of cross-platform numerical equivalence.
